title.en: Retrieve the encryption public key of a phone number

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您WABA下已新增号码，且已通过号码验证。

- 若您WABA下没有新增的号码，请调用[GetChatappVerifyCode](~~600746~~)、[ChatappVerifyAndRegister](~~600770~~)接口获取验证码校验并注册号码。

#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this operation, make sure that a phone number has been added under your WABA and has passed phone number verification.

- If no phone number has been added under your WABA, call the [GetChatappVerifyCode](~~600746~~) and [ChatappVerifyAndRegister](~~600770~~) operations to obtain a verification code and register the phone number.

#### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 5 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.
